title: Rethinking Procedural Audio Pre-training: Source Scaling and Objective Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2609.15067v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Procedural audio has emerged as a viable source for transferable audio representation learning, but its design principles remain unclear.We revisit two questions: how a procedural source should be scaled, and whether training choices developed on natural audio should transfer unchanged to procedural data.Using a controlled source, we separate scale into formula-class coverage C and within-class rendering diversity I.Experiments with FDSL and AudioMAE show that these two forms of scale provide different benefits and depend on the learning formulation and downstream task. A matched AudioMAE study further shows that procedural audio favors low mask ratios (10%--25%), whereas AudioSet-28K favors 50%--75%. Shared-codebook analysis reveals lower patch diversity and stronger temporal predictability in procedural audio. These results motivate source-aware procedural pre-training, where source scaling and learning configuration are considered j

translated_title: 重新思考程序化音频预训练：数据源扩展与训练目标适配
translated_abstract: 程序化音频已成为可迁移音频表示学习的一种可行数据源，但其设计原则仍不明确。我们重新审视了两个问题：程序化数据源应当如何扩展，以及在自然音频上发展出的训练策略是否可以不加修改地直接迁移到程序化数据上。利用一个受控的数据源，我们将规模分解为公式类覆盖度C和类内渲染多样性I。基于FDSL和AudioMAE的实验表明，这两种形式的规模扩展带来不同的收益，且依赖于学习方法和下游任务。一项严格对照的AudioMAE研究进一步表明，程序化音频更适合较低的掩码比例（10%–25%），而AudioSet-28K则更适合50%–75%的掩码比例。共享码本分析揭示了程序化音频具有较低的patch多样性和更强的时间可预测性。这些结果推动了源感知的程序化预训练，即在预训练中同时考虑数据源扩展和学习配置。
tldr: 该研究揭示程序化音频预训练需要对数据源扩展方式（公式类覆盖度与类内渲染多样性）和训练目标（如掩码比例）进行源感知的适配，程序化音频与自然音频需要不同的预训练配置。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that procedural audio pre-training requires source-aware adaptation of both scaling strategies (formula-class coverage vs. within-class rendering diversity) and training objectives (e.g., lower mask ratios of 10–25% versus 50–75% for natural audio).
